_comment: What the hosted Worker's privacy policy and terms (hosted_legal.js, /privacy and /terms) name that is not a catalog sentence: the date the text last changed, the operator's contact addresses (product owner, 2026-11-24), and two retention periods set outside the Worker's own code. `backup_days` is the R2 bucket's lifecycle rule, which docs/hosted-tenants.md §11.1 creates by hand, and `newsletter_hold_days` is UNMATCHED_HOLD_DAYS in src/cyris/adapters/fetch/newsletter_worker_source.py; tests/test_hosted_config.py holds both equal to their sources. Change `updated` with any change to the pages' text.
